question: To whom and under what condition is the stated rule for the liṅga and similar objects addressed?
premises: The rule concerns the liṅga and similar objects.
The rule applies when they are in an unblemished state.
The address is directed to the foremost twice-born.
inference: The specified rule for the liṅga and similar objects in an unblemished state is addressed to the foremost twice-born.
plain_english: O best of the twice-born, that is specified for the liṅga and so on when they are unblemished.
